verdict.rationale: Yapily's own docs describe a sandbox test environment where an application connects to a bank and uses test accounts to simulate the real Open Banking experience. That delivers the core of testing without production data. The pack contains only that single overview statement, so the depth of the sandbox is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit docs on separating sandbox from production (credentials or endpoints), sandbox coverage across payments and data APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
